title: lockflight.engine-lock/v1
description: The engine pin by hash, .lockflight/engine.lock, written by lockflight init and update. Policy a person commits: the engine reads it strictly. Rules the engine checks beyond this schema: the version is compared with the engine reading it, and the git-ignored local lock is the only place a development lock is accepted.

channel.description: A committed lock is always release; development only in .lockflight/local/engine.lock.

binaries.description: Platform (runtime identifier) to the SHA-256 of the extracted executable. A release lock names linux-arm64, linux-x64, osx-arm64, osx-x64 and win-x64; readers ignore a platform they do not know.
